```json
{
  "title": "Project Nexus: Immersive AI-Driven Product Configurator",
  "sprint_priority": "high",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD): Project Nexus

## 1. Executive Summary
Project Nexus is a high-end website module designed to integrate immersive 3D visualization with autonomous AI agents. Leveraging the market strengths of industry leaders like WillowTree and Appinventiv, this module will provide a premium, high-performance product customization experience built on Next.js, Three.js, and LLM-based agentic workflows.

## 2. Business Objectives
*   **Increase Conversion:** Drive a 25% increase in high-ticket item conversions through interactive 3D engagement.
*   **Reduce Support Overhead:** Utilize AI Agents to handle 70% of pre-purchase technical inquiries.
*   **Brand Positioning:** Establish the platform as a market leader in 'Spatial E-commerce' and Generative AI integration.

## 3. Target Audience
*   Enterprise B2B buyers requiring complex product visualizations.
*   High-end B2C consumers looking for personalized, luxury shopping experiences.

## 4. Functional Requirements

### 4.1. Immersive 3D Visualization (Three.js Layer)
*   **Real-time Rendering:** Users must be able to rotate, zoom, and explode 3D product models in the browser.
*   **Dynamic Material Swapping:** Real-time updates to textures and materials based on user selection.
*   **Spatial UI:** Interactive 'hotspots' on the 3D model that trigger informational tooltips.

### 4.2. Agentic Concierge (AI Agents Layer)
*   **Natural Language Configuration:** An AI agent (LangChain/RAG based) that configures the 3D model based on prompts (e.g., "Show me a version suitable for a minimalist office").
*   **Predictive Assistance:** The agent should analyze user behavior and proactively suggest upgrades or compatible accessories.
*   **Automated Quoting:** The agent must generate real-time PDF quotes based on the current 3D configuration.

### 4.3. Core Architecture (Next.js Layer)
*   **Performance Optimization:** Implementation of App Router and ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) for lightning-fast load times of product pages.
*   **SEO Excellence:** Server-side rendering (SSR) of metadata for every unique 3D configuration state to capture long-tail search traffic.
*   **Vercel Deployment:** Utilization of Edge Functions to minimize latency for AI agent responses.

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements
*   **Scalability:** Must support up to 10,000 concurrent 3D sessions using WebGL optimization.
*   **Accessibility:** Provide a high-contrast, keyboard-navigable fallback for the 3D interface.
*   **Security:** Ensure all AI interactions are filtered for PII (Personally Identifiable Information) and follow ethical AI frameworks.

## 6. Success Metrics (KPIs)
*   **Average Session Duration:** Target > 4 minutes.
*   **Configuration Completion Rate:** Target > 15%.
*   **Core Web Vitals:** Maintain an LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) under 2.5 seconds.

## 7. Technical Constraints & Dependencies
*   **Browser Support:** Must support WebGL 2.0.
*   **API Latency:** AI Agent response time must be < 2 seconds (utilizing streaming responses).
*   **Asset Pipeline:** 3D models must be optimized in GLB/GLTF formats for web delivery."
}
```
